reasoning: This is a direct application of the Pigeonhole Principle. We have 4 pigeons and only 3 holes, with each hole allowed to hold at most 1 pigeon. Since there are only 3 available slots but 4 pigeons each requiring a unique slot, it is mathematically impossible to assign all 4 pigeons without placing at least 2 in the same hole. The SAT solver confirms UNSATISFIABLE.
